messages:
jess: Heads-up 10: webinar + launch post go live Wed 11am PT. Weve got two analyst briefings Tue afternoon and a handful of press asks already. We need: 1) press kit + asset delivery owner, 2) approved quote(s) and who signs off (legal + CEO?), 3) embargo-break contingency. Thoughts?

ana: I can own the press kit (assets, logos, screenshots). Will upload to the shared drive and add a versioned folder. Link incoming. :file_folder:

ravi: Ill draft the short quote options for CEO and VP product. Want one technical and one customer-facing. Can someone confirm the customer quote contact for approvals?

jess: Customer quote is from Maya at AcmeCorp, legal already cleared a redline last week. @luke can you confirm Maya is okay with the final wording?

luke: Confirmed. Maya okayed short margin edits, wants to see final before we send.

tina: Legal wants to review any customer quote before release. Tagging @legalbot to start a review thread.

legalbot: Legal review request received. ETA 3 hours for standard customer quote clearance, 1 business day for new IP-sensitive language.

ravi: Draft quotes below, please mark preferred and any edits.

```
Customer-facing: "Redwood cut inference costs for us by nearly half while keeping latency predictable." 
Technical: "Redwooddelivered a median 38% reduction in per-token inference cost vs our baseline quantized pipeline in internal benchmarks."
```

jess: Prefer the customer-facing for the press release, technical one for analyst briefs. Legal: will that pass?

legalbot: Customer-facing is acceptable with minor wording tweak: replace "by nearly half" with "by ~50%". Technical line flagged: include benchmark context (hardware + dataset) inline or as a footnote.

ana: I'll add a one-sheet asset list and a small FAQ with the hardware/dataset footnote. Uploading to: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-assets/v2 (will add readme).

jess: Good. Now embargo-break contingency: if a reporter publishes early, we need a rapid response plan. Propose: 1) immediate Slack alert to #press-response, 2) sam (on PR) publishes a holding statement, 3) escalate to CEO comms only if factual inaccuracy or legal risk. Agree?

luke: Agree. Also add social media freeze until we assess.

ravi: I'll draft a holding statement template: short, acknowledges early post, provides link to official release, asks for corrections.

```
Holding statement draft: "Thanks for flagging. The full release will be published at 11:00 PT; please refer to the official release for confirmed numbers. If you have questions, contact press@redwood.ai."
```

jess: Solid. Whos on press@ triage Wednesday? I can cover morning up to 12:30, but need someone afternoon.

ana: I can cover afternoon. Let's make a calendar block for press triage shift and add names.

legalbot: Quick checklist for quotes: 1) customer approval screenshot, 2) legal clear, 3) CEO signoff if the quote mentions partner names or financial figures.

luke: CEO prefers to approve only final release copy, not every quote. Let's route final release to him at 10:00 Wed for 30-min review window. If no reply, proceed at 11:00.

jess: OK set CEO review for 10:00 Wed. Also need the benchmark appendix in the press kit. Who's owning the appendix?

ravi: I'll own the benchmark appendix and include methodology bullets + variance caveats. Will paste a snippet into the FAQ like: "Benchmarks run on p4d instances, 2k-context, n=15; median cost reduction 38%; variance +/-6%. Customer results vary."

ana: Uploading assets now. Adding a CHANGELOG.txt so we can track last edits.

jess: Can we run a 10-min runthrough Tue 5pm PT to validate routing (press@ -> triage -> escalation) and confirm assets link works for reporters?

luke: 5pm works. I'll test inbound email forwarding during the run.

legalbot: Final note: preserve chain-of-approval emails for compliance. Use subject prefix [LAUNCH-APPROVAL] for any quote approvals.

jess: Thanks everyone. I'll assemble the final checklist and post in #launch-ops. Please add any last edits to the doc by EOD today. :rocket:
